notes: Rule 95 classes ἕνεκεν as improper (one case, no verbal compound), so the frame heads on sake rather than on for; the proper-preposition units of rule 78 are not counter-precedent, and rule 78 names this very lexeme.
The preverb of ἐπιβαλοῦσιν is answered by the expressed ἐπί, which keeps on under rule 106, so the verb goes bare.
